# d-scaling of sample complexity (generated by dscale_analysis.py)

n* = training-set size at which the seed-mean test error reaches 0.1 (networks: 3 seeds at d = 30, 2 seeds at d = 15, 60). The race model uses its d = 30 calibration unchanged. Exponent = least-squares slope of log n* against log d over the d values where n* is finite.
